hero.title: Savor a Century of Authentic Flavor at Central Tiffin Room
hero.subtitle: Experience the timeless taste of Bengaluru's most cherished South Indian delicacies, perfected over 100 years.

about.title: Our Legacy: A Bengaluru Institution
about.paragraph1: CTR, also known as Central Tiffin Rooms, is a legendary hotel steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, we have been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages.
about.paragraph2: CTR’s rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers, Mr. Sanjeev Poojari to the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory. If there’s one thing that mirrors the brand, it is the sheer love of our patrons who have been showing us with boundless love and support for the last 100+ years.
